title: Walk a caller through ordered steps
summary: Each step names one tool, every step but the last names one next step, so the model is never offered a way to skip ahead or double back.
scenario: Opening a roadside assistance request, three questions in order

folds: variant: gather_info typed answers without tools
evidence: gather_info variant is absent from the bundled schema.json (sdk-surface §4); the claim does not depend on it
sdk contexts.py:490-533 Step.to_dict renders step_criteria, functions, valid_steps, end
sdk contexts.py:1215-1262 ContextBuilder.validate refuses an unknown valid_steps target
gather_info absent from the bundled schema.json (0 occurrences); recipe avoids it
